integrity: Unrestricted uniqueness, exact Schur identity and root monotonicity are established analytically; finite numeric and symbolic checks are supplementary. No invented external validation.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple unit-edge vertex-transitive cores of order at least three; equal nonnegative vertex-grounding prices and positive total budget. Not a theorem for general graph cores, unequal prices, trace inverse, or smallest eigenvalue. Literature coverage can be incomplete; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp spectral budget threshold for rooted-forest grounding on transitive coronas
